items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 10.1.4 at source lines 172-195: for a function f : A -> B between sets, being an epimorphism, having contractible mapping cone C_f, and being surjective are equivalent. The 61-line proof contains no citation: the first direction reduces contractibility of C_f to two induction clauses (lines 198-211) and then manufactures both of them out of a path between two elements of sm{h:B->C_f} iota o f ~ h o f, which is obtained from the dual of the author's monomorphism criterion together with function extensionality and transport in path types (lines 212-225). The second direction defines a prop-valued family on C_f by recursion, which forces a check of the meridian condition via the contractibility of an inhabited mere proposition (lines 227-242), and the third direction is a four-step equivalence chain that uses that the codomain C is a set (lines 244-256). The three directions live in different types and their bookkeeping is not recorded in the statement.
